fields.description: Physical warehouse where Synarete-owned stock is received.
fields.label: Main Warehouse

fields.description: Virtual warehouse used to keep the standard stock ledger accurate after stock is issued to a site or engineer.
fields.label: Field Issued Warehouse

fields.description: Generic Customer used on a draft printable Delivery Note for internal site issues. The WMS Material Issue remains the stock transaction.
fields.label: Internal Delivery Customer

fields.description: Debited when the engineer Consumes (stock leaves inventory). Use 5010010 - CONSUMABLES - SEL or the spare-parts expense. Not COGS unless accounts say so. Receive and Issue never use this account.
fields.label: Consume Expense Account

fields.description: Only for loading stock you already own (opening / previously expensed). Use as Difference Account on Stock Reconciliation or Material Receipt so remaining qty Debits inventory and Credits this expense. Never the supplier. Never 1040010.
fields.label: Opening Stock Adjustment Account

fields.description: If not ticked, the user who created a Site Work Order cannot Approve it. Another Warehouse or Stock Manager must Approve. Tick this if one warehouse user must do every step (create through close).
fields.label: Allow Self-Approve

fields.description: If not ticked, a Receive Batch cannot exceed the outstanding PO quantity.
fields.label: Allow PO Over-Receive

fields.description: If not ticked, Site Work Orders and ServiceNow Work Orders cannot be Completed until WMS Material Closeout is submitted (Issued = Used + Returned unused).
fields.label: Allow Complete Without Closeout
